`final class SnapshotWindowBridge`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IWindowBridge`](/reference/backends/iwindowbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.snapshot` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [SnapshotWindowBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/snapshot/SnapshotWindowBridge.java)

The window bridge of the snapshot runner, whose size, mouse, held keys, cursor and clipboard the commands set.

- [Testing your UIs](/use/learn/running/testing/)
